title.en: Chapter 34 — Fogg Equal to the Occasion

book_meta.work: Le Tour du monde en quatre-vingts jours
book_meta.author: Jules Verne

sentences.en: Passepartout fell on the quay, and wept.

sentences.ar: وفيكس وقف، وما عرف يفرح ولا يزعل.
sentences.en: And Fix stood, not knowing whether to be glad or sorry.
And Fogg looked at the sea.
And said: the next steamer is in two days.

sentences.ar: تاني يوم الصبح، فوغ راح للميناء لحاله.
sentences.en: The next morning, Fogg went to the harbour alone.

sentences.ar: سفن تجار، وسفن صيد، وسفن حرب.
ولقى سفينة زغيرة، بخارية، اسمها هنريتّا.
sentences.en: And found a small steamship, named the Henrietta.

sentences.ar: وقبطانها، أندرو سبيدي، رجل خشن، ما بيحب الركاب.
sentences.en: And her captain, Andrew Speedy, a rough man, who did not like passengers.
Fogg said: where are you bound?
Fogg said: will you take me to Liverpool?
Fogg said: I pay two thousand pounds.
Will you take me to Bordeaux?
Speedy said: at two thousand a passenger?
Speedy said: we sail at nine.
And the four boarded the Henrietta.
And Fix said to himself: Bordeaux?
I have no business in Bordeaux.
And Passepartout said to himself: Bordeaux?

sentences.ar: وفوغ قعد على السطح، وتطلع بالبحارة.
sentences.en: And Fogg sat on deck, and watched the sailors.

sentences.ar: وبعد يوم، القبطان سبيدي كان محبوس بكابينته.
sentences.en: And after a day, Captain Speedy was locked in his cabin.
And all the sailors with Fogg.
And the Henrietta was bound for Liverpool.
